purpose: Require Paper 1's learned result to demonstrate both strategy routing and longitudinal-memory routing rather than allowing any arbitrary pair of heads to satisfy the primary claim.

claim_tiers.FULL_FOUR_COMPONENT_LEARNED_PM: RS, MP, MS, and ME all pass
claim_tiers.PRIMARY_PARTIAL_MULTI_COMPONENT_LEARNED_: RS passes and at least one of MP, MS, or ME passes; every failed head is fixed OFF and named
claim_tiers.RS_ONLY_ROUTER_PRIMARY_FAIL: RS passes but no memory head passes; report the RS component result, but the Paper 1 PM primary claim fails because longitudinal memory routing was not learned
claim_tiers.MEMORY_ONLY_PRIMARY_FAIL: one or more memory heads pass but RS fails; report component results, but the Paper 1 PM primary claim fails because strategy routing was not learned
